_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Apply an embroidery effect to artwork
operations.description: Returns a flat PNG of the artwork styled to look embroidered. This is an image filter, NOT digitizing — it produces no stitch plan and no machine file. The true digitizer (Stitch AI) lives in the mockup editor and is not part of this public API.

operations.name: Render many mockups in one call
operations.description: One request, many renders — the same artwork across a product range, or a whole catalogue in one go. Costs one credit per render in the batch. Prefer this to looping createRender: it is a single round trip and is rate-limited as one call.

export_options.description: How the rendered image is returned.

renders.description: One entry per mockup to render.

operations.name: Render every mockup in a collection
operations.description: Renders one artwork across a saved collection of mockups. Use when the set of mockups is a collection you maintain in the app rather than a list you assemble per call.

export_options.description: How the rendered image is returned.

operations.name: Create a catalog
operations.description: Create a catalog of mockups.

operations.name: Generate an ai mockup from a photo
operations.description: MockAnything: give it a product photo and artwork and it generates a mockup without a PSD template. Asynchronous — returns a task id to poll with getMockAnythingStatus.

operations.name: Render production ready print files
operations.description: Returns the print file rather than the mockup image — the artwork laid out at the print area's real dimensions, for sending to production.

export_options.description: How the rendered image is returned.

operations.name: Render one mockup
operations.description: The core call. Place artwork into one mockup's smart objects and get back a hosted image URL. Costs one render credit on success. Synchronous — the response carries the finished image.

export_label.description: Your own label, echoed back on the result.

export_options.description: How the rendered image is returned.

operations.name: Poll an ai mockup task
operations.description: Poll until `status` is a terminal value. The finished image arrives on this response.

taskId.description: The task id returned by createMockAnything.

operations.name: Get one mockup
operations.description: One mockup template by UUID.

operations.name: Poll a video mockup job
operations.description: Poll until the job finishes; the video URL arrives on this response.

requestId.description: The request id returned by submitMotionMockup.

operations.name: List catalogs
operations.description: Catalogs group mockups for a storefront or a client.

operations.name: List mockup collections
operations.description: The saved sets of mockups in this workspace. A collection UUID is what createBulkRender renders across.

operations.name: List mock anything product types
operations.description: The print-on-demand product types MockAnything can generate onto.

operations.name: List mock anything scene styles
operations.description: The scene styles a generated mockup can be rendered in.

operations.name: List a mockup's smart objects
operations.description: The printable areas of one mockup. Each has a UUID you pass in `smart_objects[].uuid` when rendering.

operations.name: List the mockups available to this key
operations.description: Every mockup template the workspace can render — its own uploaded PSDs and the templates it has access to. Start here: a render needs a `mockup_uuid` from this list.

operations.name: List mockups with their smart objects
operations.description: The same list as listMockups, with each mockup's smart objects inlined. One call instead of one per mockup when you are building a render plan.

operations.name: List video mockup models
operations.description: The image-to-video models available for motion mockups.

operations.name: Turn a mockup into a video
operations.description: Submits an image-to-video job. Asynchronous — poll getMotionMockupStatus with the returned request id. Rate-limited to 10 submissions a minute.

operations.name: Upload your own photoshop mockup
operations.description: Turn a PSD into a renderable mockup. Its smart objects become the print areas you address in a render. Separately rate-limited from the render endpoints.
